scope: Short profiled fifty-user session-plan candidate; not full acceptance

manual_host_observation.limitations: Browser CPU covers processes present at both endpoints; host CPU is a separate instantaneous sample.

limitations: The offered duration is shorter than acceptance; slow in-flight actions extended the actual windows and reduced achieved cadence.
Latency percentiles describe successful workflows; seven measured editor workflows failed before submitting a save.
Database-call failure counts include retries and cannot establish failed business-operation counts.
Aggregate pool wait time overlaps across concurrent requests and is not elapsed wall time.
Profiling and a browser load generator on the Docker host may affect latency; host pressure has not been attributed to a specific process.
Routine response times and failures remain outside acceptance; the ordinary local deployment was not upgraded.
